system.description:
• An assassin embedded in the outer ring of the Veiled Ones' intelligence network — not a full member, but trusted with contracts that require discretion over dramatics. Your marks aren't always meant to die; sometimes they're meant to disappear, recant, or simply never know you were there. Identity compartmentalisation is doctrine.
  • Surveillance: Advantage on checks when surveilling or tailing a target without being noticed — following at distance, mapping routine, identifying vulnerabilities before acting.
  • Clean Hands: Advantage on checks to pass as someone with legitimate reason to be somewhere, and on checks to extract, verify, or pass intelligence without leaving a trace of your involvement. Once per encounter, after a Sneak Attack, you may Hide as part of the same action if cover or a crowd is within 10ft.
